policies.sentence: Students must reflect on whether and how AI enhanced or limited their learning and skills.
Students must explain how they used AI, how they modified its output, challenges faced and what they learned.
Each assignment includes a section for students to reflect on their use of generative AI.
Students must fill out the AI reflection form to receive credit for each assignment where they used AI.
Students must submit the AI usage reflection form by the day after submitting the work.
Students must submit the explanation of AI use as a separate document with the project.
Students must discuss their AI use during the demo with the TA.
Students are invited to share if and how they use and benefit from AI technologies.
